_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-ŋɩɩyɔɔ kɛɛ Surround kɛɛ {width}x{height} kɩɩkɛɛ.
Ɛy'aa ŋɩɩyɔɔ {player_id}. Ɖɔɔɖɛɛ kɩɩtɛɛ: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' bee w/s/a/d.
Ɖɔsɛɛ: ɛyɩɩ ɛzɩŋɩɩyɔɔ kpaa. Ɛyɩɩɖɛɛ wɛɛ kpɩɩɩŋ; kɩɩɖɛɛ kɩɩɩŋ wɛɛ kpɩɩɩŋ; kɩɩɖɛɛ kɩɩɩŋ kpɩɩɩŋ kɩɩɩŋ.

board.after_moves: Kpaɣna alɩwaatʋ kʋɖʋmtʋ taa lɛ, palaɣ-ɩ: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Aleɣya laɖʋ {player_id} sɩba, mbʋ pʋyɔɔ yɔ ɛ-lɩmaɣza taa lɛ pɩfɛyɩ ɖeu.

outcome.survived_win: Ɛyʋ {player_id} pɩzaa nɛ ɛlɩɩ kɩ-taa, ɛlɛ lalaa ñasɩba.
outcome.all_crashed: Ɛyaa mba pa-tɩŋa pasɩbɩ alɩwaatʋ kʋɖʋmtʋ taa.
outcome.outlived: Ɛ-ɛyʋ kɩbɩnʋ kaacaɣ wezuu nɛ pɩɖɛɛ lalaa.
outcome.turn_limit: Ye pɩtalɩ hɔɔlʋʋ ŋgʋ kɩ-taa pɩwɛɛ se ŋpɩzɩ nɛ ŋkɔɔ yɔ, weyi ɛɖɔkʋʋ kpam yɔ eɖewa.
